Brass Band Club (BBC)

More Than Music

Keeping children in school and building their future.

A safe space to learn and grow

Every child deserves the chance to discover their talent.

At AMEF, we believe every child deserves an opportunity to discover their talent, build confidence and develop skills beyond the classroom. This belief inspired the creation of the Brass Band Club at Asaba Memorial High School.

The club is becoming more than an extracurricular activity. It is creating a positive, safe space where students can learn, practise, perform and grow together.

AMEF provides free brass band training to students and youth, giving them the opportunity to develop their musical talents while remaining actively engaged in school.

How the Brass Band helps

Music opens pathways far beyond performance.

Helps reduce school dropout by keeping students motivated, engaged and connected to school.

Well-being & culture

A student’s story

“Joining the Brass Band changed me.”

“I used to lose interest in school, but joining the Brass Band changed me. I now enjoy coming to school, practising with my friends and learning new things. I want to continue my education and become a good musician.”
Lilian Sifa Student · Age 17 · Refugee from the Democratic Republic of Congo

For AMEF, the Brass Band is more than music. It is helping children stay engaged in education, discover their abilities and believe in their future.
